renderer: deterministic inline SVG paired marks with actual masks
primitiveBudget: eight generated SVG marks, four narrow relation corridors, four liftable paired mask cuts, and one cut polygon per spent relation
commitThreshold: the visitor must cross one corridor from one end to the other without touching either mark, then leave the field
memoryRule: a valid relation re-produces every mark from ordered drift, opens a real notch in both paired masks, and records a third absence; four cuts compound
interactionRule: pointer or touch moves through a corridor and leaves; ArrowLeft/ArrowRight selects; Enter/Space performs a deterministic pass; Delete lifts latest; Escape or R releases
representationRupture: pressure block, reciprocal glyph, and winding seal -> separate masked SVG marks with no enclosing body
compositionRupture: central body, diagonal syntax, and centred seal -> four asymmetric pairings distributed through open ground
encounterRupture: held pressure, dwell/departure, and gate-to-gate drag -> hover passage between two marks without click or target selection
temporalRupture: local load, remote reply, and winding parity -> a relation remains provisional until field departure and then becomes a third absence
mediumRupture: compound paths and open strokes -> SVG rect marks, user-space masks, and generated cut polygons
changedRule: Only a non-touching passage between two separate marks can spend a corridor as a third absence; direct attention to a mark has no causal power.
visibleConsequence: The blind view is a pale field of eight dark marks in four pairings. A valid passage opens actual notches in the two paired marks and records a third absence; four relation-cuts compound.
falsifier: Delete if a direct target, short hover, same-side path, outside path, or mark collision commits; if masks are decorative; if only colour or readout changes; if later cuts reset; or if the blind field reads as a generic target diagram.
deletionCondition: Delete v049 if caption-free viewing cannot distinguish relation-first paired gaps from v046-v048 or if the little-critters translation is not visible as a changed adjacency rule.
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
